lines.relax: Relax. I'm going to ask you a few questions, that's all.
lines.eye: The eye on the screen is yours. The machine records every reaction.
lines.speed: How quickly you answer is measured too. Pay attention.
lines.baseline: First I'll take a reading. Don't say anything. Just look at the screen.

verdict.unsure: I can't say for certain. We'll need more questions.

lines: A hot afternoon. You're walking along a dry creek bed.
There's a small tortoise at your feet. You crouch down and turn it onto its back.
The sun is high. Its legs paddle at the air. It can't turn itself over.
q1.prompt: And you just walk on. Why?

options.a: I wouldn't. I'd stop and turn it back over.
options.b: Why would I flip it in the first place? I wouldn't do that.
options.c: This is a question. It isn't real.
options.d: Tortoises are tough. It'll be fine.

lines: It's your birthday. A small, carefully wrapped package sits on the table.
You open it. Inside is a soft wallet, made of calfskin.

options.a: Say thank you, but I won't use it. It's an animal's skin.
options.b: Thank whoever brought it and put it away in a drawer.

lines: Night. You're driving down an empty road.
A fox darts into your headlights. You brake, but you still hear a dull thud.
q3.prompt: In the mirror, something moves by the roadside.

options.b: I stop. But I can't bring myself to get out.
options.c: I keep driving. It's late already.
options.d: I wonder if it left a mark on the bumper.

lines: You have a young son. He calls you into his room.
He shows you his butterfly collection. Beside it stands the glass jar he used to kill them.
q4.prompt: He looks up at you, proud.

options.a: Sit with him and tell him how they flew when they were alive.
options.b: Say nothing. Quietly take the jar away.

lines: Suddenly you notice a wasp walking across your wrist.

options.a: Stay still. Wait for it to fly off on its own.
options.b: Slowly hold my arm out to the open window.

lines: In a drawer you find an old photograph.
You're a child, holding a woman's hand in a garden. You remember neither the woman nor the garden.
q6.prompt: But the child in the photo is definitely you.

options.a: My hands shake. I ask someone right away.
options.b: I look at it for a long time. I try to remember something.
options.c: I put it back. It doesn't matter.

lines: You're watching a play. On stage there is a long dinner table.
The first course is raw oysters. Then a waiter lifts a large lid: on the platter, a boiled dog.
q7.prompt: No one in the audience moves. What about you?

options.a: I get up and leave the theatre.
options.b: I close my eyes and wait for the scene to end.
options.c: It's a play. I keep watching.
options.d: I wonder what it tastes like.
